package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaiofighter;

/** Standalone Java 11 tests for low-allocation AIO Fighter hot-loop gates. */
public final class KspAioFighterActionThrottleTest
{
    private static void check(boolean result, String message)
    {
        if (!result) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        KspAioFighterActionThrottle throttle = new KspAioFighterActionThrottle();
        KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action npc = KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action.NPC_SEARCH;
        KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action gear = KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action.GEAR_CHECK;
        KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action loot = KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action.EMPTY_LOOT_SCAN;
        KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action style = KspAioFighterActionThrottle.Action.COMBAT_STYLE;

        check(throttle.ready(npc, 1_000L, 350L), "First attack search must be immediate");
        check(!throttle.ready(npc, 1_100L, 350L), "Do not spam NPC searches every 100ms");
        check(throttle.ready(npc, 1_350L, 350L), "Search resumes when due");
        check(throttle.ready(gear, 1_100L, 700L), "Gear check is independent of NPC scans");
        check(!throttle.ready(gear, 1_400L, 700L), "Equipment check should not run on each loop");
        check(throttle.ready(gear, 1_800L, 700L), "Gear check resumes when due");

        check(throttle.ready(loot, 1_000L, 180L), "Initial loot search must be immediate");
        check(!throttle.ready(loot, 1_100L, 180L), "Empty loot scan should be throttled");
        throttle.invalidate(loot);
        check(throttle.ready(loot, 1_101L, 180L), "Loot scan invalidation must be immediate");

        check(throttle.ready(style, 10_000L, 800L), "Initial style check must be immediate");
        check(!throttle.ready(style, 10_100L, 800L), "Style check is too frequent");
        throttle.invalidate(style);
        check(throttle.ready(style, 10_101L, 800L), "Training skill switch forces immediate style verification");

        throttle.reset();
        check(throttle.ready(npc, 10_110L, 350L), "Restart clears previous NPC delay");
        check(throttle.ready(gear, 10_110L, 700L), "Restart clears previous equipment delay");
        check(throttle.ready(style, 10_110L, 800L), "Restart clears previous style delay");

        System.out.println("PASS: independent AIO Fighter throttle gates, cooldowns, reconfiguration and restart");
    }
}
